scope: Implementation and measurement decisions; source generations are explicit in each dataset. No universal fastest claim.

decisions.summary: Expose automatic conversion and a separate no_alloc mode; keep direct backend controls under internals.
decisions.reason: A small public API permits dispatch changes while tests/benchmarks retain explicit backend comparisons.

decisions.summary: Table retention is opt-in; larger NTT tables remain conversion-owned.
decisions.reason: Cold setup and retained heap are distinct tradeoffs. Earlier unbounded resource data is historical.

decisions.summary: Keep the final v011 matrix/Divisor storage changes and early temporary drops.
decisions.reason: Requested allocation and peak-heap reductions are retained with source-bound controls; paired timing changes are mixed.

decisions.summary: Keep specialized 32/64-byte matrix paths for their exact sizes.
decisions.reason: Exact-size and general matrix paths have separate measurements; nearby-length padding is a separate decision.

decisions.summary: Keep Toom-3 outside the normal production dispatch.
decisions.reason: Historical complete grids do not establish a broad production win and code-size/other-backend tradeoffs remain.

decisions.summary: Do not reintroduce broader IFMA threshold-state plumbing without a new hypothesis.
decisions.reason: Older matched worker and ordinary-consumer no-LTO results differ; the ordinary consumer already folds the tuning atomic and has decoder regressions.

decisions.summary: Do not broadly pad other lengths to the fixed 32/64-byte paths.
decisions.reason: Pattern, wrapper, setup and size controls did not support a general replacement. Full experiment remains archived.

decisions.summary: Do not attribute the retained native/cache slowdown to no_std, rename or const tables.
decisions.reason: A literal unchanged ELF copy at a different inode/path recovered performance; no PMU evidence established a cause.

decisions.summary: Keep the original variable-step NTT loops.
decisions.reason: The six-loop prototype has mixed timings and grows linked native x86 sections despite a small M5 reduction.

decisions.summary: Keep the original inverse-scale arithmetic; retain the new independent tests and scalar proofs.
decisions.reason: Two equivalent formula variants did not improve the joint local code/read-only footprint. No timing or GCP result is claimed.

decisions.summary: Treat the bounded Wasm panel prototypes as experiments; no new default target policy follows.
decisions.reason: The exact modules, clocks, code-size changes and source controls must be assessed together.

shared_limits: One deterministic fixture per primary size is not every input distribution.
Process ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Source-matched associations do not make instrumented workers identical to public consumer binaries.
Requested Rust heap, allocator overhead, RSS and Wasm pages are different metrics.
Historical input and archive locators are not active documentation paths.
